caption_L1: Economic loss due to major droughts worldwide from 1900 to 2016 (in billion U.S. dollars) is a bar plot. The x-axis plots Economic loss in billion U.S. dollars while the y-axis shows Drought.
caption_L2L3: The United States has suffered the world's greatest economic loss due to drought over the 116 years of the data set. The US has lost approx 30bn US dollars in total. This is followed by China at about 18bn dollars, and Spain at around 7bn USD. The US has suffered three major droughts in all, with the worst economic losses in 2012.
